definition: Collects, dismantles, recycles or safely disposes of discarded equipment, including decommissioning replaced equipment through licensed recyclers or take-back schemes.
Extends the life of equipment through reuse, repair or refurbishment, including refurbishment centres.
Requires a plan, protocol or procedure for handling, storing and disposing of the e-waste the project's own equipment generates, for example in its environmental and social instruments.
Prepares or adopts an e-waste strategy, law, regulation, standard or extended producer responsibility scheme, or builds the capacity of the bodies that enforce it.
